newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 8.0 cts/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 8.0 cts/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market fell another eight cents a kg to 556 cents at sales in Sydney and Geelong, Wool International (WI) said.
In merinos, 19 micron was 5.0 percent cheaper, while 20 mm was three percent cheaper and 21 mm was two percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings of 19 and 21 mm were two percent cheaper and 20 mm was three percent cheaper. Crossbreds were cheaper, with the exception of 31 mm which was unchanged.
WI said most interest came from Japan and Western Europe with support from other sectors.
Of the 26,266 bales offered, 15.7 percent were passed in, WI said.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Geelong, with about 25,400 bales on offer, WI said.
